digest.component_or_area: Git fetch stall detection test suite
propositions: Full-suite scheduler load causes git-fetch dribble tests to intermittently and incorrectly classify valid traffic as stalled due to delayed Python fixture wake-ups reducing actual throughput below configured rate

The test suite applies a 2-second low-speed abort window to both zero-byte stall controls and above-floor negative controls, but libcurl abort decisions cannot be made deterministic under scheduler delays
Cumulative bytes-owed calculation alone cannot prevent libcurl stall abort if scheduling delays cause one uninterrupted gap exceeding the configured window before catch-up recovery
The production 10-second window must not change; the fix separates fast 2-second zero-byte stall tests from one production-window real Git integration test and makes pacing math deterministic
